description: The chart illustrates the accuracy and token count for four different categories, represented by distinct colors: red, orange, blue, and green. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with the corresponding colors in a legend below the chart, and are identified as CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, although the red category is not explicitly labeled. The vertical axis on the left represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, while the vertical axis on the right represents token count, ranging from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. The bars for accuracy are colored according to the category, with values of 91.19% for the red category, 80.89% for CoD (orange), 88.50% for CCoT (blue), and 88.40% for CoUT (green). The token count bars, also colored by category, have values of 676.85 for the red category, 534.24 for CoD, 445.91 for CCoT, and 354.46 for CoUT. The bars are grouped by category, with each category having two bars representing accuracy and token count. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
